craft_notes: Sthāyin: nāda-vīra of heard doings resolving to jaya-śānta of conquering close — the treatise ends in blessing (end-prosperity). Place-means-shock kept triple; whose-are-these-these heard (doubling kept). Rejected: (a) single these → killed: doubling points. Read aloud: THAT — PLACE, MEANS, SHOCK … WHOSE-are-THESE, THESE-heard.

lines: That — place, means, shock — spirited working, natured, being —
Vaikharī's doings — whose are these, these heard.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sā sthānakaraṇāghātapuṃvyāpārātmikā satī vaikharī vṛttayo yasyāstā imāḥ śrutigocarāḥ

reads_against.argmap: What sounds are heard? → Place-struck spirit-natured; Vaikharī functions audible.
c1_essence: Place-struck natured being; heard Vaikharī doings.
reads_against.c1_rasa: nāda-vīra of heard doings; vīra of straitened exchange; karuṇa-adbhuta of unenjoying goddesses; vīra of all-ways entering; vīra of attained mystery; jaya-śānta of conquering close
